Lowering Utility Bills | US Congressman Josh Riley Upstate New Yorkers pay some of the highest utility bills in the country, and greedy corporations are trying to charge even more – all while service deteriorates and their foreign parent companies post record profits. It’s robbery. Josh is fighting them every step of the way, to hold the utility monopolies accountable and lower your bills. SHARE YOUR STORY: What do rising utility bills mean for you? Saving You Money The very first bill Josh introduced in Congress will help families save up to $400 a year by making energy-saving home upgrades that cut utility bills. Josh’s Weatherization Enhancement and Readiness Act is a straightforward way to keep heat in, bills down, and more money in your wallet. Keeping the Lights Local Foreign-owned utility companies like NYSEG & Central Hudson want us to pay more while they rake in record profits and send millions overseas. Josh introduced the Keep the Lights Local Act to ban foreign ownership of utilities, because that money should stay in our community, not line the pockets of foreign executives. Banning Bonuses for Utility Executives Last year, the parent companies for Central Hudson and NYSEG paid their CEOs more than $10 million each—even as they asked us to pay higher rates. Josh’s bill, the No Bonuses for Utility Executives Act , is simple: if utility companies raise rates on us, they can’t turn around at the same time and dole out millions in bonuses to their CEOs. It’s just basic fairness. Opposing Rate Hikes Utility bills are an emergency, and Josh is treating them that way. He opened an investigation into the billing practices of Upstate utility companies, and when NYSEG and Central Hudson tried to raise rates again, he took them to court — the first time a member of Congress has ever stepped into a rate case to stop a utility from hiking prices. He’s using every tool he has to lower costs. Share Your Story This isn’t about politics or Washington BS. It’s about standing up for people all across Upstate New York who are sick of being squeezed by utility companies that are already making a fortune. Bringing Down Costs | US Congressman Josh Riley Working families in Upstate New York are getting squeezed from every direction. That’s why Josh is working across the aisle to take on the special interests, lower costs, and make life a little easier for you. Cracking Down on Price Gougers When you go to the store, you should be able to count on fair prices. Instead, greedy corporations can charge whatever they want for essentials – even in a crisis when you need them the most. Josh’s Cracking Down on Price Gouging Act holds bad actors accountable when they try to exploit emergencies to rip people off, because no one should get rich by screwing over working people. Lowering Healthcare Costs Healthcare should be a civil right, not something that forces families into bankruptcy or drives corporate profit. Josh is taking on Big Pharma with the Lowering Drug Costs for American Families Act , which will expand Medicare’s power to negotiate fair, affordable drug prices for everyone. And his Medicare Dental, Vision, and Hearing Benefit Act expands Medicare to cover the basic care seniors have been denied for too long. Tackling the Housing Crisis Having a fair shot at the American Dream means being able to afford a place to live, raise a family, and retire with dignity. But right now, Upstate New York’s housing crisis is pricing too many people out of our communities. Josh is leading the charge to drive down costs with the Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act, which will cut red tape and spur the construction of nearly two million new affordable homes. Eliminating Taxes on Social Security Our seniors have worked hard their entire lives, and every penny they received from Social Security is a penny they’ve earned. Josh’s You Earned It, You Keep It Act eliminates federal taxes on all Social Security benefits and puts money directly back into senior’s pockets.

Fighting Corruption | US Congressman Josh Riley Washington is broken. Too many politicians go there to get rich and cling to power, not to serve the people who sent them. Josh is fighting corruption to make government work for everyday Americans—not the career politicians or the special interests lining their pockets. Getting Dark Money out of Politics Special interests spend millions to influence elections and buy members of Congress, who go to Washington and vote for their priorities, not ours. It’s corrupt as hell. Josh’s Ban Corporate PACs Act would get corporate dark money out of politics and put the people back in charge. And he’s pushing to overturn the Supreme Court’s Citizens United decision and get dark money out of our politics for good. Banning Insider Trading Too many politicians use their office to enrich themselves by trading stocks based on insider information. Josh’s Restore Trust in Congress Act would ban members of Congress and their spouses and children from trading individual stocks, and require them to divest or place assets in a blind trust. It’s a commonsense step to make sure no one is abusing their elected position for profit. Implementing Term Limits We need new voices and fresh ideas in our politics because the status quo just isn’t working. Josh is leading the effort to implement term limits —three terms in the House, two in the Senate, and that’s it.

Fighting for Rural Communities | US Congressman Josh Riley For too long, Washington and Albany have treated rural communities like ours as an afterthought. Josh is fighting to make sure our farmers, small towns and local economies aren’t left behind, and that Upstate New York finally gets its fair share. Standing Up for Family Farms Big ag monopolies have too much power, and family farms pay the price. Josh is fighting to level the playing field so local farmers—not corporate giants—come out ahead. Josh’s Local Farmers Feeding Our Communities Act helps get fresh, local food to schools and families while supporting the farmers who produce it. And when Washington bureaucrats tried to back out of contracts with more than 150 Upstate farms, Josh introduced the Honor Farmer Contracts Act to force the government to keep its word. We kept the pressure up and won–every single contract cancelled by the administration to our Upstate farmers has now been restored. Expanding Access to Healthcare Reckless policies in Washington have pushed rural hospitals to the brink, and left families driving hours just to see a doctor. Josh is working across the aisle to ensure everyone can get the care they need close to home with the CONNECT for Health Act , which expands coverage of telehealth services , and the Rural Hospital Stabilization Act that helps the providers serving our communities keep their doors open. Repairing Our Bridges and Roads Too often, Upstate families are forced to drive on crumbling roads and dodge dangerous potholes. That’s why Josh introduced the Agricultural & Rural Road Improvement Act to help repair and modernize the roads and bridges we rely on. Better infrastructure means lower costs, fewer delays, and safer trips.
